title: Summoning team present the night of the egg

tellings.quote: I can tell you that that night there was another team present that I know of that uh deals with the summoning component of data collection.

plain: On the night in 2014 when, by his account, he used his helicopter to retrieve an egg-shaped craft in the California desert, a man named Jake Barber says another team was there too, one that 'deals with the summoning component of data collection,' meaning efforts to call such craft to appear. Barber tells Michels he knows of this team firsthand; if true, it would mean the government not only recovers these objects but tries to draw them in.
